dedupe_keys.name: four representations of the swiss railway network 2025

description: This data set gives four network representations of the Swiss railway network as of 2025, built from timetable data of the Open Data Platform Mobility Switzerland (opentransportdata.swiss). In all four the nodes are the complete set of Swiss train stations. Space-of-Changes has a directed edge between any two stations joined by a direct service without changing trains; Space-of-Stops has a directed edge between stations served by at least one non-stop train; Space-of-Stations has an undirected edge between geographically adjacent stations; and a temporal network holds each train connection with its start time and duration. Files are a node list, edge lists for the four representations and two files of edges manually removed and added to meet the Space-of-Stations definition. Coverage is national. Access: free CSV files on figshare under CC BY 4.0, version 2 published 21 October 2025. Caveats: it reflects one timetable year, and the manual edits to adjacency follow the authors' definition. The networks support network flow, resilience and cascading failure studies of rail services, such as station or link removal. They complement opentransportdata.swiss and the SBB open data platform catalogued here.
